description: ARM storage account without infrastructure encryption or blob soft delete
note: A DELIBERATE GAP as of 2026-09-23, kept rather than deleted so the gap is recorded rather than forgotten. CIS Azure 4.2 (infrastructure encryption) was detected on ARM only by Trivy's AZU-0061, and Trivy no longer scans ARM (docs/trivy-azure-arm-adapter-gap.md). Neither KICS nor checkov has an infrastructure-encryption query for ARM, so this template -- which genuinely lacks it -- now raises nothing at all. 4.2 is reachable only from Terraform. Re-label this case the day either tool adds the query.
